stories.title: Ue-Canada: tecnologie, Artico, difesa, energia, materie prime e IA al centro della nuova alleanza

en.title: EU-Canada: technologies, Arctic, defence, energy, raw materials and AI at the centre of new alliance
en.summary: The EU and Canada are expanding their relationship beyond the existing 2017 free trade agreement, which generated over 130 billion in trade value in 2025, aiming to deepen cooperation across multiple strategic sectors.

stories.title: L'alleanza Canada-Ue fa infuriare Trump. Carney a Strasburgo: "Più forti insieme"

en.title: Canada-EU alliance infuriates Trump. Carney in Strasbourg: "Stronger together"
en.summary: The US President threatened substantial tariffs if Europe grants Canada associated membership status, while the Canadian Prime Minister received standing ovation at the European Parliament.

stories.title: Il rabbino aggredito a Milano: “Ho avuto paura, ma resto qui e con i miei abiti tradizionali”

en.title: Rabbi assaulted in Milan: "I was afraid, but I stay here in my traditional clothes"
en.summary: A rabbi who was attacked in Milan stated he experiences regular antisemitic incidents on the streets and noted that another rabbi had been assaulted previously, citing growing antisemitism.

stories.title: Caso Roggero, inammissibile la seconda istanza di differimento pena

en.title: Roggero case, second deferment of sentence deemed inadmissible
en.summary: The Milan Surveillance Court rejected a second request to defer the sentence in the Roggero case.

stories.title: Bollo auto, scontro Renzi-Meloni. “Mi davi del venditore di pentole”. “Tu annunciavi, noi facciamo”

en.title: Car tax, clash between Renzi and Meloni. "You called me a pots and pans seller". "You announced, we act"
en.summary: Italy's Premier Meloni and Italia Viva leader Renzi exchanged critical remarks on social media regarding car tax policy.

stories.title: Caso Roggero, il gioielliere resta in carcere: inammissibile l'istanza di differimento della pena

en.title: Roggero case, jeweller remains in prison: request to defer sentence is inadmissible
en.summary: A jeweller sentenced to 14 years and 9 months for killing two robbers and injuring a third during a shop attack had his request to defer serving his sentence rejected.

stories.title: Requisiti, durata e mezzi: tutto ciò che c'è da sapere sull'esenzione del bollo auto

en.title: Requirements, duration and means: everything you need to know about car tax exemption
en.summary: Car tax exemptions in Italy apply to one vehicle per person and include motorcycles, but exclude commercial vehicles.

stories.title: Trump minaccia l’Europa sull’asse con il Canada: “Dazi molto elevati o stop agli scambi” Video

en.title: Trump threatens Europe over Canada axis: "Very high tariffs or stop to trade"
en.summary: The US President threatened substantial tariffs or trade restrictions on Europe in response to the EU granting Canada associated membership status.

stories.title: Social, la svolta dell'Ue: divieto per gli under 13. Von der Leyen: "Schermi catturano l'infanzia"

en.title: Social, EU turning point: ban for under 13s. Von der Leyen: "Screens capture childhood"
en.summary: The European Union is introducing restrictions on social media use for children under 13 through the Kids Act, with supervised parental access permitted until age 15.

stories.title: Bollo auto, ecco chi risparmia e chi resta escluso dalla nuova esenzione

en.title: Car tax, here's who saves and who is excluded from the new exemption
en.summary: The government introduces an exemption from vehicle tax for lower-powered cars and motorcycles, with specific eligibility criteria and power thresholds determining which models qualify.

stories.title: Quando Meloni diceva: "Abolire il bollo auto? Nemmeno Cetto La Qualunque"

en.title: When Meloni said: "Abolish car tax? Not even Cetto La Qualunque"
en.summary: Meloni previously criticized a proposal to suspend car tax for low-income Calabrian families, but the government has since announced a national vehicle tax exemption for certain vehicle categories based on power rather than income.

stories.title: Rabbino aggredito a Milano, tre persone già individuate: “Preso a calci e pugni”. Lui li filma

en.title: Rabbi assaulted in Milan, three people already identified: "Kicked and punched". He films them
en.summary: A rabbi in Milan was attacked and managed to photograph the three assailants as they fled before contacting authorities.

stories.title: Gestione stress, lavoro di squadra e comunicazione, l’eredità dei 20mila volontari di Milano Cortina

en.title: Stress management, teamwork and communication, the legacy of Milan Cortina's 20,000 volunteers
en.summary: Randstad's assessment highlights that volunteers from the Milan Cortina Olympics acquired highly sought-after skills that young people can leverage in the job market.

stories.title: Emergenza plastica, le imprese: «A rischio la raccolta»

en.title: Plastic emergency, businesses warn of collection at risk
en.summary: Unindustria, an association representing Lazio region businesses, warns that a plastic emergency threatens to paralyze the recycling sector and urban waste collection services.

stories.title: Rinnovabili, in Sardegna finanziati interventi per 85 milioni di euro

en.title: Renewables, 85 million euros in funded interventions in Sardinia
en.summary: A renewable energy project for private citizens exceeded capacity, with over 5,000 applications and approximately 85 million euros distributed over three years.

stories.title: Inox, produttori delusi dalla nuova Salvaguardia

en.title: Stainless steel, producers disappointed by new safeguard
en.summary: Stainless steel producers express dissatisfaction with a new safeguard measure, stating it provides no positive effects and penalizes them due to export quota allocations to India.

stories.title: Sardegna: in stallo il rilancio della filiera dell’alluminio, pressing sul Mimit

en.title: Sardinia: aluminum sector revival stalled, pressure on Mimit
en.summary: Sardinia's aluminum industry remains unable to restart, with recent meetings at the Mimit ministry producing no progress on the Eurallimina dispute.
